title: Longest Non-Decreasing Run
prompt:
**Description:** Print the length of the longest contiguous non-decreasing run in
the array.

**Input:** Line 1: n (1 <= n <= 100000). Line 2: n integers (|a[i]| <= 10^9).
**Output:** One integer — the longest run length.

**Example:** `6` / `1 2 2 1 3 4` -> `3` (1 3 4).

tests.name: sample
all equal
tests.hint: Non-decreasing allows equality — the whole array.

tests.name: strictly down
tests.hint: Every run is a single element.

tests.name: single
max n
